raw.title: Arazzo Debugger 0.0.5
raw.body:
First platform-specific release of the Arazzo Debugger VS Code extension.

## Fixed

- **Debug adapter now works on Windows, Linux, and Intel macOS** (#2). Versions 0.0.1–0.0.4 were published as a single universal package bundling only an Apple Silicon macOS adapter binary — Windows showed "bundled debug adapter binary not found", and Linux/Intel macOS failed to spawn the adapter. The extension is now built and published per platform, and each VSIX bundles a native `arazzo-debug-adapter` binary, so no Cargo/Rust toolchain is required.

## Added

- Windows ARM64 (`win32-arm64`) build target (experimental).

## Install

- **Recommended:** install or update from the VS Code Marketplace — it selects the correct platform build automatically.
- **Manual:** download the VSIX for your platform below, then `code --install-extension <file>`.

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
